results.name: AC1a message_agent legacy wake/inject semantics kept (not QueueOnly remap)
AC1b message_agent cannot restore takeover (no marker, no takenOver field)
AC1c message_agent cannot bypass completion arbitration for a second body
AC1d default guidance points at the new tool surface
AC2a mid-flight result returns status only, no draft body
AC2b no infinite re-read: normal repeat is a reference, reread is explicit
AC3 resume stays a maintenance entry; followup restores the session internally with a distinct run
AC4a identity-unknown registry records are held for review, not turned into completions
AC4b already-delivered historical notifications are not replayed after reload
AC4c unknown pending recovers via migratePending and reload keeps it pending (no retry, no loss)
AC4d committed body repairs a ledger ACK write failure after restart
AC4e queued Push is re-arbitrated before drain, not owned at enqueue time
AC5a notifications normal does not accidentally wake a finished parent
AC5b quiet and none are preserved (no reset to normal)
AC5c legacy idle_rearm config loads without error and is inert
AC5d old takeover marker files are tolerated (read, ignored, no error)
